notes:
Luna Beta-0 RC1

- test(luna-os): Wyse 3040 profile stage (2 GB RAM, slow cores, throttled 8 GB eMMC, 20 000-file family drive)
- test(luna-os): installer-prompts finds the smaller disk by size, not by kernel name
- fix(lunad): marker probes of unmounted sticks take turns with peek and inspect
- fix(lunad,web): eject stops Luna's own scans first and waits for them; big uploads carry on after a dropped connection; 'can't find this drive' says what is true
- style(lunad): cargo fmt; ci checks the e2e launcher's syntax
- test(luna-os): harness reads slow guest commands and the installer countdown reliably
- fix(lunad): a drive that filled up is no longer called read-only for fifteen minutes; harness repairs
- fix(luna-os,lunad): the power button shuts Luna down (acpid); a full drive no longer hides its uploads
- fix(lunad): abandoned uploads no longer hold a drive's space until the next restart (hourly sweep)
- fix(lunad): lists stay true after copy/move jobs, WebDAV and other background writes; USB sticks get time to show up before the recovery scan
- test(luna-os): the update rehearsal check ignores comments and the failed-update notice
- fix(luna-os,lunad): an interrupted OS update no longer leaves the spare slot unbootable; GRUB falls back to the other system on its own
- test(luna-os): e2e stages for factory reset, password recovery, OS-update power cuts on a raw disk; rollback cases use a broken lunad in both places
- fix(luna-os,lunad): OS updates could not find the boot partition (GPT name ESP vs LUNAESP); USB bus detection in the updater
- fix(luna-os): OS updates were impossible: the image had no tune2fs or e2label
- test(luna-os): harness covers rollbacks, power cuts during an update, installer prompts; WebDAV regression test fails fast instead of hanging
- fix(lunad): a drive plugged in across a reboot is mounted again instead of showing as ejected; harness: restarts, crash loop, stale-image guard
- feat(luna-os): keep lunad's log on the data partition so it survives reboots; log drive state changes
- fix(lunad): a stick pulled without ejecting works again when plugged back in; a reused kernel name no longer revives the wrong drive
- fix(lunad,web): blank or unreadable USB sticks can be erased and added; unplugged drives say so; bad names get plain errors
- fix(lunad): WebDAV uploads no longer hang past the first few KB or on Expect: 100-continue
- fix(lunad,luna-os): log lunad to /var/log/luna.log and supervise it; plain errors for bad names, full drives and damaged uploads; hide lost+found
- test(luna-os): end-to-end QEMU harness (iso/e2e.sh) for install, boot, setup and drives
- fix(luna-os): one-shot boot scripts no longer show as crashed; root goes read-only after bootmisc
- fix(lunad): USB drives that report non-removable (external HDD/SSD) are no longer hidden
- …and 7 more changes
